mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns, as elevated interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns show a positive Rank IC with FEDFUNDS level over any 3-year rolling window, or the t-test for the mean return difference between high and low FEDFUNDS quintiles is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 202.0 (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that triggers a market reaction of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as investors anticipate central bank policy responses that stabilize growth without triggering recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 202.0, or the mean return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of elevated FEDFUNDS (above 4.5%) and low UNRATE (below 4.0%) signals a 'Goldilocks' economic regime where growth is strong but inflation is contained, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The mean 20-day return in periods meeting the trigger condition is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or the condition is met in more than 60% of the time but returns are negative in more than 50% of those periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 200.0), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are negative due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The mean 20-day return in periods meeting the trigger condition is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or the condition is met in more than 60% of the time but returns are negative in less than 40% of those periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1800 thousand units signals an economic slowdown that triggers a market reaction of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as investors anticipate central bank policy responses that stabilize growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1800, or the mean return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A lower industrial production (INDPRO) level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as falling industrial output signals an economic contraction that increases risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns show a positive Rank IC with INDPRO level over any 3-year rolling window, or the t-test for the mean return difference between high and low INDPRO quintiles is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as investors anticipate continued economic growth without immediate inflationary pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or the mean return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A lower year-over-year GDP growth rate (computed from GDPC1) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days, as falling economic growth increases the risk of recession and reduces corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show a positive Rank IC with GDP growth rate (computed from GDPC1) over any 3-year rolling window, or the t-test for the mean return difference between high and low GDP growth quintiles is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
